projects.title: Assistive Indoor Navigation
projects.subtitle: Vision-language indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users
projects.summary: AI-powered indoor navigation using vision-language reasoning to support blind and low-vision users.
highlights: Combines scene understanding, floor-plan reasoning, and navigation guidance.
Designed around accessibility and practical indoor mobility workflows.

projects.title: WildfireVLM
projects.subtitle: Vision-language wildfire detection and risk assessment
projects.summary: Vision-language system for early wildfire detection and risk assessment from satellite imagery; accepted at IGARSS 2026.
highlights: Connects visual wildfire evidence with language-based risk interpretation.

projects.title: Claude Code Encyclopedia
projects.subtitle: Searchable Claude Code, Codex and GitHub CLI reference
projects.summary: A searchable reference covering Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI and GitHub CLI in one encyclopedia UI: commands, flags, settings keys, hooks, gh workflows and configuration paths, with OS-aware examples. GitHub CLI entries are loaded from a structured JSON catalog so adding a command is a data edit.
highlights: One encyclopedia UI for Claude Code, Codex CLI and GitHub CLI, with family filters and deep links.
504 embedded Claude and Codex entries, plus 99 GitHub CLI records across nine JSON-backed sections.
OS-aware examples, version awareness, keyboard navigation, and local favorites.
Older catalog URLs redirect into the encyclopedia and keep family, search and hash.

projects.title: ADHD Study Pack
projects.subtitle: Pomodoro workspace for an ADHD attention system
projects.summary: A browser-based Pomodoro workspace built around how an ADHD study session actually falls apart: a focus dial with intervals you can shrink to a two-minute start, an Eisenhower matrix that separates loud from important, a week planner that auto-schedules study blocks into your free hours, one keystroke to park a distracting thought, and statistics that show when you actually focus well.
highlights: Eisenhower priority matrix with drag-and-drop, one-at-a-time triage and a check on where focus time really went.
Week planner with courses, weekly targets and an auto-scheduler that favours your historically best hours; .ics import and export.
Focus dial with interval presets, activation rating, distraction tally, brain dump and a body-double mode.
Synthesised focus sounds, breathing and grounding tools, and Google sign-in that syncs the workspace across devices.

Comfort profiles for conflicting needs — ADHD by default, with Calm and predictable, Low vision, Easier reading and Screen reader as starting points, then every setting adjustable: WCAG 2.2 AA, NVDA, JAWS, Narrator, VoiceOver and TalkBack, and a built-in voice for reading aloud.
